sources.title: [SYNTHETIC DEMO SOURCE] Reflective Roof Membrane Aging and Radiative Flux Bounds in Dense Districts
authors: Flowden Reference Fixture Generator (Synthetic Example — Not a Real Citation)
sources.summary: Synthetic demonstration source modeling 36-month solar reflectance attenuation and dew-point condensation cycles on high-albedo roofing membranes.

excerpts.quoted_text: Across simulated 36-month particulate deposition cycles, unwashed thermoplastic membranes declined from 0.82 to 0.64 solar reflectance, reducing peak midday roof surface cooling from 18.4 K to 11.2 K.
excerpts.annotation: Quantifies the 36-month weathering bound used in Note 01 (High-Albedo Cool Roof Membranes).

excerpts.quoted_text: In coastal basins where nocturnal relative humidity exceeds 78%, sub-ambient radiative cooling drops untreated membrane surfaces 1.8 K below ambient dew point, promoting biofilm colonization unless fluorinated or siliconized topcoats are specified.
excerpts.annotation: Explains the moisture-condensation tradeoff highlighted in the synthesis matrix.

sources.title: [SYNTHETIC DEMO SOURCE] Street-Canyon Leaf Area Index and Nocturnal Longwave Trapping
authors: Flowden Reference Fixture Generator (Synthetic Example — Not a Real Citation)
sources.summary: Synthetic demonstration source evaluating pedestrian Mean Radiant Temperature (MRT) reduction versus nocturnal Sky-View Factor longwave trapping in vegetated street canyons.

excerpts.quoted_text: In synthetic canyon simulations with aspect ratio H/W = 1.5, increasing crown Leaf Area Index (LAI) from 1.2 to 3.8 lowered pedestrian-level Mean Radiant Temperature (MRT) by 14.6 K at 14:00 local solar time, while reducing canyon Sky-View Factor below 0.35 and slowing post-sunset air cooling by 1.1 K.
excerpts.annotation: Primary quantitative basis for Note 02 (Vegetative Canopy Evapotranspiration) and the nocturnal SVF tradeoff.
